initial_plan.metric: Annual sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed, representing pedestrians killed in reported crashes
initial_plan.denominator: None; this is a count, not a rate or share
initial_plan.population: Police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025

data_check.evidence: The planned period contains 2,132,218 crash rows and zero rows with a missing crash_date. Each requested year has observed dates from January 1 through December 31. Of the rows, 0 have a missing pedestrian-fatality value, 0 have a negative value, and 2,130,554 have zero pedestrian fatalities.
data_check.meaning_and_decisions: All 2013-2025 crash rows can be assigned to a requested calendar year; no rows are dropped for missing dates or missing/impossible outcome values. The 2,130,554 zero-outcome rows are valid crashes with no pedestrians killed, not missing/default unknowns, and remain in the crash population. There is no endpoint evidence of a partial year; all requested years show both calendar endpoints. No change to the initial plan.
data_check.limitations: This counts pedestrian fatalities as recorded in police-reported NYC crash records; it does not independently establish completeness or accuracy of reporting. Date endpoints indicate full calendar-year coverage, though they do not test for gaps in records within a year.

final_plan.metric: Annual sum of number_of_pedestrians_killed, representing pedestrians killed in reported crashes
final_plan.denominator: None; this is a count, not a rate or share
final_plan.population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crash records with crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025, including records with zero pedestrian fatalities
final_plan.filters: crash_date from 2013-01-01 through 2025-12-31; no outcome-value exclusions are needed based on the check
final_plan.years: 2013-2025 inclusive; each has observed dates from January 1 through December 31
final_plan.limitations: Counts rely on pedestrian fatality values as recorded in police-reported NYC crash records. Full year endpoints are present, but the check does not establish within-year completeness or independent reporting accuracy.
